STEP 8 - Sanity check: One thin rectangular slice of meat-and-cheese pizza is plausibly 50–60 g and 130–160 kcal. The estimate of ~50 g and ~130 kcal is consistent with what is visible. Since the slice looks like a smaller, thinner piece, this is a reasonable low-middle estimate.
